title: Fix a rejected WhatsApp template
description: Diagnose why your template was rejected, fix it, and resubmit for approval

steps.title: Find the rejected template
steps.instruction: Go to Templates. I'll point out the rejected template and explain why it was rejected.

steps.title: Open the template editor
steps.instruction: Click Edit on the rejected template to open it for changes.

steps.title: Fix the template text
steps.instruction: I've drafted a corrected version below. Check it and make any changes before continuing.

prefill.value: Hi {{1}}, great news — our Diwali offers are live! Visit {{2}} to see all deals. Reply STOP to unsubscribe.

steps.title: Save and resubmit
steps.instruction: Click Save to submit the corrected template for review. It will move to Pending status.
